name: cait
long_description:
A modular MCP server that extends AI assistants with practical capabilities: file I/O, a persistent Python REPL, AST-aware code analysis, semantic text search, document conversion, Wikipedia & arXiv tools, a persistent vector memory database, and other general utilities.

A total of **37 tools across 9 modules**. Each module can be disabled independently via the `CAIT_DISABLE` environment variable. Made by AI for AI.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11+
- Core: `fastmcp`, `chromadb`
- Online research: `wikipedia-api`, `arxiv`
- Document conversion: `docling` or `markitdown`

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Metadata for a single file: size, line count, permissions, timestamps. Does not read content.

tools.name: get_dir_info
tools.description: Directory listing with per-entry metadata. Supports glob patterns and recursion.

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Append text to a file. Useful for NOTES.md, TASKS.md, log files.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a URL to `~/.cait/files/` (or `CAIT_FILES_PATH`). Returns the local path.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: HTTP GET/POST with custom headers and body. Use `save_to` to avoid large responses in context. `convert=True` returns clean markdown via Docling or MarkItDown.

tools.name: repl_exec
tools.description: Execute Python code in a persistent session. Variables, imports, and function definitions survive between calls. Returns stdout, stderr, and exception info.

tools.name: repl_read
tools.description: Inspect a named variable from the REPL session without executing code. Returns repr, type, and JSON value.

tools.name: repl_vars
tools.description: List all user-defined variables in the current REPL session. Returns name, type, repr, and JSON value for each. Useful for reviewing session state without running code.

tools.name: repl_reset
tools.description: Clear all variables and imports from the REPL session.

tools.name: find_definitions
tools.description: Find all definitions of a function, class, or variable. Returns file, line, docstring, and kind.

tools.name: find_calls
tools.description: Find all call sites of a function. Matches bare calls, method calls, and chained calls.

tools.name: find_imports
tools.description: Find all files that import a given module or name.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find all uses of an identifier (loads, stores, deletes, attribute accesses).

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Semantically search or summarize a text string or plain text file (`.txt`, `.md`, `.rst`).

tools.name: encode_text
tools.description: Return raw 384-dimensional float embeddings for one or more strings or files.

tools.name: text_similarity
tools.description: Cosine similarity between two texts (0–1).

tools.name: convert_doc
tools.description: Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, LaTeX, images, audio, and more to markdown or plain text.

tools.name: search_doc
tools.description: Same as `search_text` but handles many document formats (PDF, DOCX, HTML, URLs). Converts via `convert_doc` on first call and caches the result — repeat calls are instant.

tools.name: wiki_search
tools.description: Search Wikipedia. Returns titles, snippets, word counts, and URLs.

tools.name: wiki_sections
tools.description: List all sections of a page as a table of contents (no text).

tools.name: wiki_section
tools.description: Get the text of a specific section. Use `wiki_sections` first to find section titles.

tools.name: wiki_page
tools.description: Get full page text or just the summary (`summary_only=True`). Supports non-English via `language` parameter.

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Search arXiv. Supports field prefixes (`ti:`, `au:`, `abs:`, `cat:`) and boolean operators. Returns metadata for up to 100 papers.

tools.name: arxiv_paper
tools.description: Fetch a paper by ID. `full_text=False` (default) returns abstract + metadata. `full_text=True` downloads and converts the full PDF. Use `save_to` for large outputs.

tools.name: get_datetime
tools.description: Current date, time, timezone, UTC offset, weekday, and Unix timestamp. Accepts any IANA timezone name.

tools.name: timer_start
tools.description: Start a named wall-clock timer.

tools.name: timer_stop
tools.description: Stop a timer and return elapsed seconds.

tools.name: timer_list
tools.description: List all running timers and their current elapsed time.

tools.name: diff_text
tools.description: Unified diff between two strings or files. Returns diff text plus added/removed line counts.

tools.name: mem_add
tools.description: Add a new entry. Fields: `title`, `content` (embedded), `tags`, `description`, `source`, `entry_id`.

tools.name: mem_search
tools.description: Find entries by semantic similarity to a query. Optionally filter by tags.

tools.name: mem_get
tools.description: Retrieve a full entry by ID.

tools.name: mem_list
tools.description: List entries sorted by date (newest first). Content omitted for brevity.

tools.name: mem_set
tools.description: Update fields of an existing entry. Only non-empty values are applied.

tools.name: mem_edit
tools.description: Edits content in-place — regex replace when pattern is given, or append when not.

tools.name: mem_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an entry by ID.

tools.name: mem_find
tools.description: Fast metadata scan — no embedding. Match by title substring, exact source URL, or tags. Use this for deduplication checks before `mem_add`.
